name: cells
title: Cells kit
description: Table cells that make rows look finished: avatar with name, status badge, number with a rolling value and coloured delta, a progress meter that fills on view, a self-updating relative time, and a mono ID with a copy button.
docs: Import PersonCell, StatusCell, DeltaCell, ProgressCell, RelativeTimeCell and IdCell from components/eased/cells/cells. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
